authorization: Owner in chat 2026-09-25: fair same-setup comparison of free models (Qwen vs Gemma 12B), minimalist Opus-like recipe, filters, multiple passes, 16k/2k+32k/4k inputs; evaluate on ZIB/KISSKI.
configs_note: 2 models x 3 arms x {1,2,3 formats} x stages; every config reported on DEV and TEST
decoding: identical for both models: temperature 0, seed 9, thinking disabled, no response cache, no transport retries, no format fallback

downstream_stages.combined: all windows of the arm merged, no verification
downstream_stages.verified-qwen: common strict Qwen verifier (same model/settings as the Qwen recipe), contexts = the windows that produced each candidate
downstream_stages.verified-self: Gemma cohorts only: the same verifier program run by Gemma itself

extraction_arms.A-minimal-8k: Opus Bootstrap program artifacts/experiments/model-native-wuerzburg-350/opus-bootstrap/program.json (hand-written instruction + its one worked example), 8,000/1,000-character windows
extraction_arms.B-minimal-16k32k: same program on 16,000/2,000 and 32,000/4,000-character windows, outputs combined with src.extractor.merge
extraction_arms.C-gepa-16k32k: artifacts/analysis/selection-finalists/0-program.json on 16k/2k + 1-program.json on 32k/4k, combined (the current Qwen recipe)

failure_policy: as in results/test-eval-20260924/plan.json: failures recorded, never abort a cohort; missing verdict rejects that candidate; a config is eligible only if every paper has output and <=5% windows/batches failed

formats.chat8192: DSPy ChatAdapter, no JSON fallback, 8,192 output tokens
formats.schema8192: ControlledJSONAdapter with the exact output JSON schema (vLLM json_schema), 8,192

pick_rule: Selection uses DEV only. Among eligible configs with DEV recall >= 80% (>= 92/115), pick the highest DEV precision, preferring the config with fewer model calls when within 2 DEV matches; if none reaches 80%, pick the highest DEV recall with DEV precision >= 15%. The pick's TEST result is its held-out estimate. TEST is reported for every config but never used to choose.
pooling: offline, per model x arm x stage: chat only; chat+schema8192; all three formats (src.extractor.merge)
question: With everything but the extraction model held fixed, how do self-hosted Qwen 3.6 35B and Gemma 4 12B compare, and does a minimal prompt (as used by the Opus row) match the GEPA prompts?
replicate_note: Arm C x qwen x all formats x filtered-title is a fresh second TEST generation of the current pick (QWEN-POOL3), giving a direct run-to-run spread.

splits.dev: 21 DEV papers, 115 definitions (frozen DEV inputs and metadata titles)

test_use: Second use of TEST (first: results/test-eval-20260924). Configs are pre-declared here; nothing is rerun after TEST results are seen.
